A digest that changes on every task state change currently invalidates every chat's KV cache (10x read-cost lever) and injects topically-related distractors that measurably degrade the model (Chroma context-rot). tasks.text: Make claim_token a checked monotonic fence: a per-task generation counter incremented on each (re)claim, validated by compare-and-swap on every .tasks.json mutation (status change, note, completion), rejecting stale generations. A held-but-unchecked UUID does not prevent a resurrected zombie worker's late write from corrupting the store (Kleppmann). Ref: research #5.

Size task leases for multi-minute LLM latency and renew them via an in-loop heartbeat at <50% of TTL emitted from inside the ralph iteration loop; reclaim only on missed heartbeats, not a fixed wall-clock guess, to avoid spurious reclaims of healthy-but-slow workers. Ref: research #6, Temporal AI-agent guidance.
